subject: general
question: Which air mass is warm?
solution:
The correct answer is** '__Continental Tropical__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tropical air masses**,** ****designated by the letter 'T',** are warm/hot as they originate over the lower latitudes of both land and sea.
 
• An air mass is a large volume of air in the atmosphere that is mostly uniform in** temperature and moisture**.
 
• Air masses can extend thousands of kilometers in any direction and can reach from ground level to the **stratosphere—16 kilometers** (10 miles) into the atmosphere.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An air mass is a vast volume of air that has a consistent temperature and humidity.
 
• These masses can extend over thousands of miles horizontally across the Earth's surface and vertically from the ground level to the stratosphere, which is 10 miles high.
 
• Air masses originate from source regions that provide them with their uniform temperature and moisture.
 
• Due to low wind speeds, these large air volumes remain stationary over a particular region and acquire the region's temperature and humidity conditions.
 
• As wind speeds increase, they move to other areas while still retaining the characteristics of their source region.
